item.title: Automating patch management with Ansible, and the GUI I built so it would actually get used
item.description: Ansible could always patch a fleet. Making it safe to run at 2am — dry-run discipline, a guard that refuses a second concurrent run, and audit evidence produced as a byproduct rather than assembled by hand — is where the work went.
